description: Work out how, changing nothing: routes, removal prices, free spots, rocket flights, mining yields, aim angles. Read only.

route.summary: a cable, pipe or chute route between ends, ports or networks, reported as build would report it; answers build_arguments

start.description: (route) {at}, {id} of a piece, {id, port} or {id, ports: [...]} of a device, or a list.

end.description: (route) One end: {at}, {id} of a piece, {id, port} of a device, or {network}.

reroute.description: {id: [...]} or {between: [end, end]}: replace an old run; leave out start and end.

trunk.description: Bus mode instead of end: {waypoints} or {cells} every start branches from.

grade.description: cable: normal, heavy (default), super_heavy; pipe (required): gas, liquid, insulated_gas, insulated_liquid; chute: chute.

allow.description: door_keepout: may enter a door keep-out; split: removals may split networks.

split_long.description: Split long straights the route meets.

avoid.description: Extra cost for room interiors or walkways.

avoid_networks.description: true, or networks: keep beside no other network.
avoid_networks.x-script: True, or networks: keep beside no other network.

axis_order.description: Which way the route turns first.

margin.description: Search box margin around the ends.

allow_bridge.description: Networks and devices whose joining is meant.

root.description: The device would_split measures cut-off against.
root.x-script: The device would_split measures cut-off against. (default every supplier)

join_to.description: The network the route must end on.
join_to.x-script: The network the route must end on. (default end's network)

join_trunk.description: Add a missing tap to join_to.

reserve_cells.description: Cells kept free for another run.

reserve_ports.description: {id, port} ports whose joining cell stays free.

assume_removed.description: Things planned as if gone; the kind's pieces are removed in the same job.

include.description: links: every added and lost link; notes: fixed text; network_devices: each network's devices.

summarize.description: The report in short instead of whole.

rows.description: Cells the report lists; 0 for none.

near.description: [x, y, z], "player", "looking_at" (the crosshair) or an id.

side.description: The side you view the plane from.

looking.description: Search the face your look ray hits.
